title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 thin-history batch 4
notes: Fresh-main deterministic top-five one-event depth batch after merge 04953b4ab585947fe106085d7265c3fbeec3d92d. Selection comes from current canonical queue: AQUA Wallet, Bitkit, Breez, Blixt Wallet, Satochip. Historical Wave 03 queue IDs are not identity authority. No launch dates are inferred.

events.title: AQUA documented its beta non-custodial Bitcoin and Layer 2 wallet scope
events.description: AQUA's first-party wallet terms, last updated 2025-04-17, documented the product as beta software and a non-custodial Bitcoin and Layer 2 wallet supporting USDt, Bitcoin, Liquid assets, peer-to-peer swaps, and multiple on/off-ramp integrations.

events.title: Bitkit documented native-app rebuild, Wake to Pay, and Bitcoin Maps
events.description: Bitkit announced a major mobile update built on a native-app rewrite, adding Android Wake to Pay for background Lightning receiving and an integrated Bitcoin Maps feature while retaining its LDK-based Lightning node.

events.title: Breez Mobile 0.17.bugfixes.5 released
events.description: Breez published the 0.17.bugfixes.5 mobile-wallet release on 2025-01-14, continuing the 0.17 line with bug fixes and signed release artifacts.

events.title: Blixt Wallet v0.8.0 moved to React Native New Architecture
events.description: Blixt Wallet released v0.8.0 on 2025-07-01, migrating the app to React Native New Architecture, replacing its lnd, Tor, and SQLite backends with new open-source libraries, updating lnd to 0.18.4, and rewriting Android periodic chain syncing.

events.title: Satochip applet v0.15-0.1 added beta MuSig2 support
events.description: Satochip published applet v0.15-0.1 on 2025-06-16 with experimental MuSig2 support and a secnonce-reuse protection mechanism validated against BIP327 test vectors.

evidence.title: AQUA Wallet Terms of Service
evidence.notes: First-party wallet terms document beta status, non-custodial architecture, Bitcoin and Layer 2 scope, USDt/Liquid support, swaps, and on/off-ramp integrations; the document update date is used conservatively as discovery chronology.

evidence.title: What Is New in Bitkit: Native Performance, Wake to Pay, and Bitcoin Maps
evidence.notes: First-party Bitkit article documents the native rewrite, Android Wake to Pay, and integrated Bitcoin Maps.

evidence.title: Breez Mobile 0.17.bugfixes.5
evidence.notes: Official Breez repository release documents the 0.17.bugfixes.5 build and signed release artifacts.

evidence.title: Blixt Wallet v0.8.0
evidence.notes: Official Blixt repository release documents the React Native New Architecture migration, backend-library changes, lnd update, and Android chain-sync rewrite.

evidence.title: Satochip applet v0.15-0.1: MuSig2 support (beta)
evidence.notes: Official Satochip applet release documents experimental MuSig2 support, BIP327 test-vector validation, and secnonce-reuse protection.
